12. UPDATE FROM CITY ATTORNEY — provided an update on the e -bike law changes for 2026.
  Legislators have revised the law to address the mechanics of the vehicles, focusing on aspects
  that  are  more  relevant to law enforcement  rather than  allowing  local  jurisdictions  to regulate
  rider behavior ( e.
  g.,age  requirements, safety  gear, etc.). The law now focuses  on  regulating
  vehicles that do not meet the definition of an  e -bike ( e.
  g.,lack  of pedals). He also shared that
  San  Diego County  has faced
  significant challenges  with  e -bikes,
  prompting special legislation
  that  allows  jurisdictions within the county to further regulate the behavior of e -bike
  local
  operators ( e.
  g.,age of operator, impoundment of bikes if the rider is not wearing a helmet).
